separateRequests: Different case number or requested remedy requires a separate JV-744; same case number may include different adjudication dates through JV-744A.

branches.probation: JV-744 item3 requests a new dispositional order; not a court finding of eligibility.
branches.completed: JV-744 item4 requests redesignation; not an assertion that relief has been granted.

serviceActors.self_represented: The court serves the request; do not add adult CR-401 requirements.
serviceActors.attorney: The attorney must serve the request; actual service is not inferred from preparation.

reserved: All JV-746 findings, disposition, conditions, denial, resealing and judicial signature/date
Optional hearing requests, appearance waiver, original-judge waiver and interpreter election require explicit answers
limits: Current protected result remains review; no eligibility, canonical admission, payment or private delivery authority.
Additional source facts and prospective questions are not yet wired into protected owner saving.
Exact juvenile official-form finalization, output/qualified-language acceptance and actual owner delivery remain required.
Destruction under11361.5 is separate; no destruction or automatic resealing inferred.
